seoTitle: How to Use Jotform on Facebook Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to add a Jotform tab to your Facebook business page in 2026 and share form links across your timeline to capture leads directly.
intro: Reaching an audience where they already spend time means bringing your form to Facebook instead of asking people to leave the platform. This guide covers publishing a Jotform tab to your business page, authorizing the connection, and sharing standalone form links in timeline posts for mobile-friendly lead capture.

steps.heading: Open the Publish panel
steps.body: Open your form project and click the Publish tab menu.

steps.heading: Select the Facebook platform option
steps.body: Choose the Platforms menu and select the Facebook option to begin the connection.

steps.heading: Add the Jotform tab
steps.body: Click Add Jotform Tab, log into Facebook, select your target business page, and grant the required app permissions.

steps.heading: Customize the tab
steps.body: Adjust the navigation tab position and set the display name shown to visitors.

steps.heading: Share and track submissions
steps.body: Generate mobile-friendly links for timeline posts, test that submissions work through Facebook, and review collected leads in your Jotform dashboard.

faq.question: Do I need admin access to my Facebook business page for this?
faq.answer: Yes, you need permission to add apps and tabs to the business page in order to connect and install the Jotform tab.

faq.question: Will submissions collected through Facebook appear in my Jotform dashboard?
faq.answer: Yes, submissions made through the embedded Facebook tab or shared link flow into the same Jotform submission dashboard as any other entry.

faq.question: Can I share the form link directly in a Facebook post instead of a page tab?
faq.answer: Yes, you can generate a standalone mobile-friendly link and share it directly in timeline posts or groups.

faq.question: Is adding a Jotform tab to Facebook free?
faq.answer: Adding the tab itself is free, though your form's available features still depend on your existing Jotform account plan.
